# infisical_audit_log_stream_azure (Resource)

Stream organization audit logs to Azure Monitor. Requires a plan with audit log streaming and an identity with organization settings permissions. Only Machine Identity authentication is supported.

## Example Usage

```terraform
terraform {
  required_providers {
    infisical = {
      # version = <latest version>
      source = "infisical/infisical"
    }
  }
}

provider "infisical" {
  host = "https://app.infisical.com" # Only required if using self hosted instance of Infisical, default is https://app.infisical.com
  auth = {
    universal = {
      client_id     = "<machine-identity-client-id>"
      client_secret = "<machine-identity-client-secret>"
    }
  }
}

# Streams into an Azure Monitor custom log table, which is how audit logs reach Microsoft
# Sentinel. The app registration needs the Monitoring Metrics Publisher role on the Data
# Collection Rule.
resource "infisical_audit_log_stream_azure" "sentinel" {
  credentials = {
    tenant_id     = "<your-entra-tenant-id>"
    client_id     = "<your-app-registration-client-id>"
    client_secret = "<your-app-registration-client-secret>"
    dce_url       = "https://<your-dce>.<region>.ingest.monitor.azure.com"
    dcr_id        = "dcr-<32-hex-characters>"
    clt_name      = "InfisicalAuditLogs_CL"
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `credentials` (Attributes) The Azure Monitor delivery credentials. Secret values cannot be read back from the API, so drift in them is not detected. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--credentials))

### Optional

- `filters` (Attributes) Scopes which audit logs the stream receives. Omit to stream every product. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--filters))

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The audit log stream ID.
- `stream_mode` (String) How events are delivered. Read-only: new streams are always created in batch mode.

<a id="nestedatt--credentials"></a>
### Nested Schema for `credentials`

Required:

- `client_id` (String) The Entra ID application (client) ID.
- `client_secret` (String, Sensitive) The Entra ID application client secret. Must be 40 characters.
- `clt_name` (String) The custom log table name to write to.
- `dce_url` (String) The Data Collection Endpoint URL.
- `dcr_id` (String) The Data Collection Rule immutable ID, in dcr-<32 hex characters> format.
- `tenant_id` (String) The Entra ID tenant ID.


<a id="nestedatt--filters"></a>
### Nested Schema for `filters`

Optional:

- `products` (Set of String) Products to stream: secret-manager, cert-manager, kms, secret-scanning, pam, agent-vault, organization.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

```shell
terraform import infisical_audit_log_stream_azure.example <audit_log_stream_id>

# The API never returns the client secret, so the first plan after an import shows it being set.
# Everything else (tenant, client, DCE, DCR, table name) is imported as configured in Infisical.
```
